svg.title: Hardman and Jacobs Undergraduate Learning Center — Floor 1
svg.desc: Editable vector floor plan redrawn from the supplied first-floor image and the original project SVG. Original room geometry and room codes are retained, with gray room fills, darker hallways, a bold perimeter, green exit labels, stair and elevator symbols, a legend, and a compass. Schematic drawing, not a measured architectural survey. Compass orientation follows the supplied first-floor drawing.
